Your setup-help message

I would like to use the Business Before Agents framework, but I am not familiar with GitHub or installing files.

Please read the guided setup at:
https://github.com/brewser123/business-before-agents/blob/v0.1-preview.1/BOOTSTRAP.md

First, tell me whether you can access that guide and its bootstrap.json file. Then guide me through the easiest setup method available in this version of ChatGPT or Claude.

Please follow these rules:
- Assume I have no experience with GitHub or AI Projects.
- Use plain language and give me only one step at a time.
- Do not ask me to use command-line tools, Git commands, or programming.
- Do not claim the framework is ready until every required file has been verified.
- If you cannot access the files directly, tell me exactly what to click, download, extract, or upload.
- Do not ask me to share confidential business information during setup.
- Stop after setup is complete and wait for me to say: “Start the Business Before Agents discovery interview.”

What happens next?

  1. Your assistant checks access. It should tell you whether it can read the approved GitHub files.
  2. It verifies the framework. It checks the project name, version, and every required file before continuing.
  3. It guides any manual steps. If direct access is unavailable, it explains exactly what to click and add—without Git commands.
  4. You choose when to begin. Setup stops before the interview and waits for your instruction.

Using ChatGPT?

Use a private Project when possible.

A Project can keep related chats, sources, and instructions together. GitHub availability varies by plan and workspace, so the setup prompt includes a manual fallback.
